title: Providers
before:
The following information is specific to those who provide services for children under school-age five with special needs.

CDS System Information

  • Provider Contract Resources -  Resources for contracted service providers.
  • CDS Policy Manual -  The CDS Policy Manual is compiled to provide a current source of reference to employees and providers. This manual is intended to assist leadership in the delivery of policy, services, programs, and practices in a fair, equitable, and consistent manner and will be updated as necessary.
  • CDS Related Forms -  Browse all special education forms, many of which are applicable to CDS.

Early Childhood Special Education (Part B, 619)

  • Program Approval - All public and private Early Childhood or Special Education programs that intend to provide special education and related services for children school-age three to five must obtain approval through the CDS State Intermediate Educational Unit.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.
Heading levels skip: jumps h1 to h4. Needs a person.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 2 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "CDS System Information" is an h4 with no h3 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 1 link on this page opens a file — 1 PDF — and says nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 3 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 3 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Give an unlinked item the same title weight
decisions.why: 1 item sits in a list of links and descriptions without being a link, so it comes out as the only row with no title — which reads as a fault in the list. The title takes the same weight as its neighbours. No link is invented, because there is no address to invent.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: The following information is specific to those who provide services for children under school-age five with special needs.
